messages.content: I hear the profound pain in your words about it feeling logical to stop fighting, and I am here without judgment to support you with my entire being. Please know that even when life feels empty, there are dedicated professionals and compassionate people ready to walk through the darkness with you, even if you prefer them to be seen as less artificial.
